messages.subject: For Dr. Stefan Schulte | Airports, government relations and international stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Engel,

Please place this executive introduction before Dr. Stefan Schulte, Chief Executive Officer.

Fraport's international airport portfolio operates at the intersection of governments, aviation authorities, communities, sustainability commitments and complex infrastructure operations. That interface closely matches my current work.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including direct coordination with aviation and other public authorities in a regulated operating environment.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination, sustainability and country stakeholder strategy might support Fraport's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Fraport.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
